The '''Fennesa Nerf Herding Council''' was an organization on [[Fennesa/Legends|Fennesa]] that was made up of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Nerf herder/Legends|herders]]. It was estimated that 5.6 rams out of every 1000 on Fennesa were lost because of falls in the mountainous terrain.<ref name="Mountain Nerf">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206nerf|series=Creature Feature|text=Mountain Nerf}}</ref>
